sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Expatriate Worker Cross-Border Money Transmission Service

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Revision, effective 1 January 2019), Articles 23, 25, 26, 37, 49, 50 and 51; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 2, 4, 6, 12 and 29; Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Company Registration; Measures for the Administration of Non-bank Payment Institutions issued by the People's Bank of China, specifically provisions governing registered capital and payment business licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration at the place of incorporation of the wholly foreign-owned enterprise
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application (establishment filing form) together with the notarized Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report, submitted through the SAMR integrated enterprise registration system
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital applies for an ordinary WFOE under the PRC Company Law and Foreign Investment Law, which adopt the subscribed capital and self-commitment system. However, because ISIC 6619 cross-border remittance services require a PBOC non-bank payment institution business license, the paid-in registered capital must be at least RMB 30 million for regional remittance business, or RMB 100 million if the company applies for nationwide clearing and remittance service coverage. The capital must be paid in cash from the foreign shareholder's own offshore account, remitted by SWIFT to the company's designated foreign exchange capital account, and monitored by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. There is no blocked escrow account requirement imposed by SAMR, but the paid-in capital remains subject to SAFE capital account control and may not be withdrawn without lawful capital reduction or regulatory approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [●] CO., LTD., A WHOLLY FOREIGN-OWNED LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY INCORPORATED UNDER THE COMPANY LAW OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA. WHEREAS the subscribers have agreed to establish [●] Co., Ltd. under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China with a registered capital of RMB [●], to be wholly contributed by the Taiwan shareholder named in the Articles of Association; WHEREAS the intended business scope includes cross-border remittance and money transmission auxiliary services classified under ISIC 6619 and the company will apply for the non-bank payment institution license from the People's Bank of China; WHEREAS the Articles of Association provide a paid-in contribution schedule, designate the legal representative, and authorize the establishment of board governance; NOW THEREFORE, the Board of Directors hereby resolves as follows: FIRST, that the registered capital of RMB [●], divided into [●] monetary units, is adopted and ratified and that the subscription schedule in the Articles of Association is confirmed in all respects. The shareholder shall pay its subscribed capital to the company's designated capital bank account by lawful wire transfer, and the General Manager is instructed to verify each remittance and maintain a complete capital ledger with supporting SAFE filings. SECOND, that the registered office of the company is adopted at the premises described in the lease as [●], that such office shall be used for all corporate correspondence and statutory notices, and that the Legal Representative is authorized to execute the lease documents and to register the address with the Market Supervision Administration. THIRD, that the Board authorizes the opening and maintenance of the company's basic deposit account, foreign exchange capital account, and such segregated payment settlement accounts as the People's Bank of China may require. All corporate payments, wire transfers, and remittance settlements shall require the joint signature of the General Manager and one Director, or such other dual authorization as the Board may fix. FOURTH, that [●] is appointed Executive Director and General Manager, [●] is appointed Supervisor, and [●] is appointed Legal Representative. Each officer is authorized to prepare, execute, and file the establishment registration application, the Articles of Association, consent forms, and all ancillary declarations with SAMR, PBOC, SAFE, and the tax authorities. FIFTH, that the officers are delegated all powers necessary to complete the incorporation, obtain the business license, affix the company seal, open the bank accounts, and take all actions incidental to making the company operational. This resolution is binding on all shareholders, directors, and officers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Registration and Business Scope Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration under the State Administration for Market Regulation, online enterprise name reservation platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application for a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company using three ranked alternative trade names in Roman alphabetic form, accompanied by a statement that the registered capital will be paid under the Articles schedule and a precise business scope description aligned with ISIC 6619 covering cross-border remittance and payment-related auxiliary services. The Taiwan foreign investor must provide its certificate of incorporation, a board resolution authorizing the WFOE investment, a bank reference, and valid passport copies. The SAMR system will screen the proposed names against identical, similar, politically sensitive, and trademark-protected names. Upon approval, the name is reserved for six months, during which the applicant must complete notarization and preparation of the Articles of Association. If the name cannot be approved on priority, an administrative reconsideration may be filed or an alternate name selected to maintain the filing timeline.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Foreign investor's certificate of incorporation and notarized English translation
Board resolution of the Taiwan shareholder approving the WFOE incorporation
Passport copies of the proposed director and legal representative
Proposed business scope in ISIC and SAMR business-scope descriptors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is rejected or suspended, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the local Market Supervision Administration, change the distinguishing element and resubmit, or simultaneously reserve a second alternate name to preserve the application slot.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Legalization and Adoption of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: PRC-recognized notary public office and, for the Taiwan investor documents, the competent cross-strait notarization and document verification service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange for the Taiwan shareholder's company registry extracts, director appointment certificates, and board resolutions to be notarized in Taiwan and then verified through the authorized cross-strait notarization procedure, with English translations certified as true copies. Draft the Articles of Association in both English and Chinese, setting out the precise scope, capital contribution schedule, board structure, legal representation, and liquidation mechanism. Convene the organizational meeting or obtain unanimous written consent adopting the Articles. Ensure the final charter states the registered office, the paid-in capital schedule, and the special authorization to apply for the non-bank payment institution license. Execute all signatures, notarize the identity of the legal representative, and keep the notarized original for submission with the establishment application.
required_dossiers: Notarized and authenticated investor qualification documents
Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder
Organizational meeting minutes or unanimous written consent adopting the Articles
Declaration of lawful source of investment funds
Lease contract or ownership certificate for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is queried, the applicant shall supplement the missing corporate certificates, obtain the required legalization or verification stamps, revise the Articles by shareholder consent if necessary, and resubmit the complete notarized package without restarting the earlier name approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment Registration Filing and Business License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration under the State Administration for Market Regulation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online establishment registration form, attach the adopted Articles, the notarized investor documents, the appointment instruments of the legal representative, executive director and supervisor, the lease or ownership proof of the registered office, and the Foreign Investment Information Report. Pay the zero statutory filing fee and submit the application. The Market Supervision Administration will conduct a formal and substantive review, verify the identity of the legal representative, and issue the business license with a Unified Social Credit Code within the statutory review window. The business license will record the company name, registered capital, paid-in capital schedule, business scope, and registered office. Upon issuance, immediately proceed to seal engraving and tax registration in the fourth step. If the application is challenged, respond with a legal memorandum and, where necessary, amend the Articles and resubmit.
required_dossiers: Company establishment registration application form
Approved Articles of Association
Notarized foreign investor identity and corporate governance documents
Appointment letter of the legal representative, executive director and supervisor
Lease contract and building ownership certificate for the registered office
Foreign Investment Information Report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is suspended or queried, the applicant must file a written explanation addressing each query, correct the identified defect, and resubmit within the statutory correction period. Administrative reconsideration and judicial review are available if the authority exceeds the prescribed review deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal Engraving, Tax Registration, Social Insurance and Capital Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau authorized seal engraving center; State Taxation Administration local tax service office; SAFE-designated foreign exchange bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the business license is issued, engrave the company seal, legal representative seal, finance seal, and invoice seal under public security supervision and record the seal impressions in the police filing system. Register with the local tax authority to obtain the taxpayer identification number, complete statistical registration, and file the social insurance registration with the human resources and social security administration. Open a basic deposit account for RMB operations at a SAFE-designated bank and open the foreign exchange capital account for receipt of the paid-in capital. Submit the foreign direct investment statistics verification and obtain the SAFE registration code. Thereafter, the Taiwan shareholder may remit the subscribed capital via SWIFT into the foreign exchange capital account. The compliance officer must maintain all bank receipts for the subsequent PBOC license application.
required_dossiers: Original business license and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Legal representative identification documents
Seal engraving approval and seal filing forms
Tax registration application
Social insurance registration forms
Bank account opening application and SAFE foreign exchange registration
Capital contribution schedule and proof of foreign investment approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the capital account opening is delayed, provide the bank with the complete SAFE registration code and verified investor documents. If tax or social insurance registration is queried, submit the necessary corrections online and request a re-issuance of the certificate within the statutory correction period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: PBOC Non-Bank Payment Institution License and AML/CFT Program Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: People's Bank of China, Financial Market and Payment Services Supervision Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within six months of obtaining the business license, prepare and submit the formal application for the Non-Bank Payment Institution Business License covering cross-border remittance and money transmission services. The application package must include a comprehensive business plan, risk management framework, anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism policy, customer due diligence procedures, data protection and cybersecurity controls, settlement and clearing system specifications, IT disaster recovery plan, and proof of senior management qualifications. PBOC will conduct a high-risk special license review of the shareholder structure, management fitness, internal control systems, and technical capacity. The applicant must maintain client funds in segregated accounts and demonstrate a compliance capital buffer. Upon in-principle approval, remedy any rectification notices, appoint the qualified compliance officer, implement transaction monitoring systems, and obtain the final permit before commencing remittance activity.
required_dossiers: Non-bank payment institution license application form
Audited financial statements and capital verification report
Proof of paid-in registered capital of not less than RMB 30 million
AML/CFT policy, procedures and internal control manual
Payment processing system specifications and IT security review report
Organizational chart and senior management resumes
Fitness and propriety declarations for directors and shareholders
Client fund segregation and settlement risk management plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If PBOC raises objections or issues a supplementary materials request, the applicant may submit supplemental information within the specified deadline, amend the business scope, or restructure the shareholding. A final refusal may be challenged through administrative reconsideration or an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for industrial manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing. The applicable specialized financial licensing authority is the People's Bank of China (PBOC) Payment Services Licensing Division; municipal industrial licensing boards are not implicated because the operation is a pure digital and consulting remittance service.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable as an industrial operating license. The required statutory authorization is the Non-Bank Payment Institution Business License for cross-border remittance and money transmission services issued by the People's Bank of China.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China (MEE) and local Ecology and Environment Bureau - Applicability review not required for pure digital and consulting services
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 0: pure financial and digital service under ISIC 6619, no construction, manufacturing, chemical processing or physical industrial project triggering an Environmental Impact Assessment report, environmental registration, or EIA screening
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - no wastewater, VOC, dust, hazardous waste or production emissions are generated by the remittance platform. The only applicable obligations are general waste classification and electronic waste disposal under the PRC Solid Waste Pollution Prevention and Control Law, together with indoor office environmental quality standards for temperature, ventilation and fresh air generally established under GB/T 18883-2022.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for civil defense industrial fire certification because no physical factory, chemical storage or warehouse is involved. The standard administrative office lease must satisfy the fire code for commercial buildings, including a fire safety acceptance inspection or fire compliance certificate from the local fire and rescue authority, adequate fire extinguishers, emergency exits and emergency lighting, and, where the employee headcount crosses the statutory threshold, a workplace safety registration with the local Emergency Management Bureau under the PRC Work Safety Law.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China; online registration and compliance portal: STA Electronic Tax Office (eTax / China Tax Service).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A China-resident Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise is incorporated with the State Administration for Market Regulation and automatically receives the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code, which functions as its statutory Taxpayer Identification Number. Within 30 days of business license issuance, the legal representative or authorized agent must complete the tax registration information confirmation through the STA Electronic Tax Office by filing the business license, articles of association, legal representative identity document, registered office proof, opening bank certificate, ownership and investment schedule, and a statement of business scope. The local STA validates the record, determines VAT small-scale or general taxpayer status, and activates the applicable monthly or quarterly filing obligations. A foreign non-resident enterprise without a Chinese permanent establishment that derives China-source income or has withholding obligations must separately obtain a non-resident tax identification number at the competent STA sub-bureau in the payor's jurisdiction, using the non-resident's home-country tax identification evidence and a completed non-resident tax registration questionnaire. For the WFOE itself, no separate application is required because the Unified Social Credit Code is the tax identity; the entity is treated as a resident limited liability company subject to entity-level Corporate Income Tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC does not maintain a U.S.-style check-the-box election or a hybrid mismatch entity election. A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise is mandatorily classified as a resident enterprise for Corporate Income Tax under the Enterprise Income Tax Law and cannot elect pass-through status. Separate VAT small-scale and general taxpayer status is governed by turnover thresholds and is not an entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-Added Tax) of the People's Republic of China; standard headline rate is 13% for goods, while financial and money-transmission services are generally chargeable at the statutory 6% rate unless qualifying cross-border services are zero-rated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All incorporated companies must complete VAT registration with the STA at establishment, with no universal turnover exemption for the WFOE. Mandatory VAT general taxpayer registration is triggered when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; entities with annual turnover below RMB 5,000,000 may be treated as small-scale VAT taxpayers, and a newly formed WFOE may voluntarily register as a general taxpayer through the eTax platform where anticipated revenue or input-credit requirements justify it.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The PRC operates mandatory electronic invoicing under the fully digitalized electronic invoice framework and Golden Tax Phase IV. VAT invoices must be issued through the STA-approved electronic invoice service platform or certified third-party systems integrated by API with the electronic tax office. Each fully digitalized e-invoice carries a unique automatically generated invoice code and cryptographic tax-control code; real-time fiscal upload to the STA occurs at issuance, and the invoice must pass central authentication before the buyer may claim input VAT credit. Anti-fraud digital stamping is performed through centralized invoice data validation, digital signatures, QR code verification, and matching against the taxpayer's VAT declaration and customs records. For business-to-business financial services, fully digitalized e-invoicing is the mandatory issuance channel and paper-only invoicing is not permitted for the zero-rated cross-border corridor.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods, zero-rating requires physical export from Chinese customs territory, customs release of the goods in the name of the exporting WFOE, receipt of foreign exchange settlement, and retention of the complete customs and transport documentary chain. For services and intangible assets, the supply must be a qualifying cross-border taxable service consumed wholly outside China with a recipient located outside the PRC. The WFOE must hold a written cross-border service contract, evidence of actual service delivery outside China, outbound payment documentation, and foreign exchange repatriation records. For the Taiwan cross-border remittance rails, 0% VAT will be recognized only where the service is supplied to an offshore recipient for use in an offshore clearing or corridor market, is not consumed or exploited in China, and is not an onshore RMB clearing service; otherwise the supply remains taxable at 6%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bill of Entry) issued in the name of the WFOE and bearing the customs release registration number
Bill of Lading or equivalent multimodal transport document evidencing physical movement from Chinese customs territory to the overseas consignee
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) issued by the designated foreign-exchange bank evidencing repatriation of export or service proceeds within the statutory deadline
Signed cross-border service contract, commercial invoice, and delivery or service-consumption evidence confirming offshore use of the Taiwan remittance corridor
SWIFT payment and settlement records for the cross-border money transmission rails, including MT103 or MT202 confirmations where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Failure to substantiate zero-rating causes the tax authority to assess VAT at the applicable rate, with the financial services rate of 6% applying to the remittance service, together with late-payment surcharges. Under Articles 52 and 63 of the Law on Tax Administration of the PRC, fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger unlimited retrospective recovery and a penalty between 50% and 500% of the underpaid tax. Use of false VAT invoices, fictitious export declarations, or forged FIRC documentation may additionally give rise to criminal liability under Article 205 of the Criminal Law. The customs authority may separately impose penalties for inaccurate export declarations, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange can penalize failure to repatriate foreign exchange within the 180-day deadline. Any VAT refund or 0% treatment already granted may be clawed back with interest if the customs declaration, Bill of Lading, service delivery evidence, or Inward Remittance Certificate is not produced on audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange of the People's Bank of China (SAFE); counterpart Taiwan-side authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: In the PRC operating jurisdiction, the RMB is convertible on the current account for legitimate trade and service payments, but capital-account convertibility is strictly regulated and subject to SAFE registration, quotas, and underlying-risk verification. The WFOE may settle incoming foreign-currency service fees, remittance-agency commissions and FDI equity injections through domestic designated banks, provided the relevant transaction documents, tax filings and SAFE codes are presented. Current-account outflows, including payments to Taiwan suppliers, licensing fees and dividend remittances, require documentation establishing commercial substance, an invoice or contract, proof of tax withholding, and a bank-verified SAFE transaction code. Profit remittance is not blocked but is operationally heavy: the annual PRC audit must be completed, corporate income tax and dividend withholding tax paid, and a board resolution plus SAFE registration submitted. Capital-account proceeds held in a capital escrow account must be used only within the approved business scope and cannot be commingled with current-account funds. Export/service receipt proceeds must be repatriated into China; no fixed statutory conversion ratio is imposed, but each bank enforces SAFE's quota-based retention limits. On the Taiwan side, TWD/USD clearing and outward remittances are monitored by CBC under the Statute for Regulation of Foreign Exchange, and cross-strait payments require clear transaction purpose codes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports, SAFE requires 100% repatriation of the export foreign-currency proceeds to a PRC-designated bank within 90 days from customs clearance; the mandatory conversion percentage is 0% under the current post-verification regime, meaning the WFOE may either voluntarily settle the proceeds into CNY or retain them within its current-account FX quota. For service-trade export receipts such as cross-border remittance agency fees, proceeds are expected within 30 days after the invoice value date and must be credited to the entity's onshore FX account; any balance exceeding the bank-aggregated current-account quota must be converted or justified to SAFE.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Escrow Account; Basic Operational CNY Settlement Account
Cross-Border Remittance Clearing Account; Current-Account FX Retention Account
Payroll and Cash Management Liquidity Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low; not viable as primary treasury infrastructure. Offshore digital EMIs are not recognized as SAFE-designated foreign exchange banks and cannot lawfully open or maintain corporate current-account or capital-account balances for a PRC WFOE. They may only serve as software or payment-aggregation providers if they avoid deposit-taking and use a licensed onshore settlement bank; any custody or settlement of FX would expose the WFOE to unlicensed cross-border payment activity. The Taiwan parent should settle through a licensed Taiwan commercial bank or a bank with cross-strait correspondent capability.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical in-branch appearance is mandatory for the statutory legal representative or an authorized director under a notarized power of attorney. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted for a high-risk remittance entity; the PRC bank requires a live interview to verify the board resolution, ID documents, corporate seals and SAFE registration records. Taiwan-issued documents must be notarized and verified through the cross-strait mechanism (SEF/ARATS) before the bank can accept them.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership obscured by a Taiwan corporate structure with nominee shareholders and intermediate holding entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete registry extracts and shareholder register of every entity in the chain; notarized Taiwan corporate IDs; notarized individual UBO declarations with national ID/passport; three-year audited financial statements of the Taiwan parent; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letters; cross-strait document authentication certificates; signed AML questionnaire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 6619 remittance agency classification as a high-risk, special-license money-service business without verifiable licenses.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PBOC Payment Business License or a confirming SAFE/PBOC letter that the WFOE operates only through licensed payment institutions; SAFE cross-border payment institution registration; AML programme and risk assessment; appointment of AML compliance officer; training records; regulatory correspondence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash pickup and non-face-to-face beneficiary payment network, which can facilitate anonymous cash layering and sanctions evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed correspondent agreements with licensed payout banks/cash pickup operators; beneficial-owner verification procedures for each payout; daily reconciliation and sub-agent list; transaction limits and velocity alerts; sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening logs; STR filing history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency between injected capital, revenue size and high-frequency remittance volumes, indicating possible trade mis-invoicing or capital-flight layering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration certificate; CPA-issued capital verification report; board-approved business plan and cash-flow budget; individual remittance service contracts; invoice and tax-filing package; dividend withholding tax clearances; intercompany transfer pricing documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan shareholder must instruct its CBC-regulated bank to send a SWIFT MT103 to the Chinese bank's designated receiving branch. The wire should reference the WFOE's SAFE FDI foreign-exchange registration number and use the SAFE-determined balance-of-payments purpose code for FDI equity injection. The Chinese bank will debit the funds to the WFOE's capital escrow account, complete the SAFE information registration, and issue a bank receipt for CPA capital verification. Conversion of the USD/TWD proceeds into CNY may be executed at the spot rate quoted by the receiving bank, with the capital-account funds restricted to the approved business purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational payments to Taiwan suppliers, service providers and agent partners should be cleared by SWIFT MT103 direct credits using a current-account FX transaction code. For goods-backed cross-strait trade, the WFOE may use commercial letters of credit or documentary collections; remittance payouts to expatriate beneficiaries are settled by MT103 to the correspondent bank, followed by local cash-pickup clearing/ATM disbursement through the licensed payout network. All outbound instructions require underlying contracts, tax invoices and SAFE transaction-purpose codes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY/USD forward contracts with a SAFE-authorized Chinese bank for current-account receipts/payments and approved FDI-related exposures.
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for matching USD/TWD/CNY interest and principal flows on approved cross-border loans, subject to authenticity and risk-need verification.
Offshore CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) may be used by the Taiwan parent for currency-hedging purposes, while onshore PRC entities are prohibited from transacting NDFs on the CNH market.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Meeting and Approval of Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Company Registration Authority; internal corporate organ: Shareholders' Meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the fiscal year end; for a calendar-year company, no later than 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the annual general meeting within the statutory window exposes responsible persons to fines of NT$10,000 to NT$500,000 (approx. USD 312 to 15,625) under Company Act; repeated non-compliance may trigger an MOEA order for dissolution or administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Financial Statements and Business Report with the Competent Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Company Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after adoption by the shareholders' meeting; in any event no later than six months after fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or deficient filing attracts administrative warnings and cumulative fines of NT$10,000 (approx. USD 312) per violation; where a legally mandated CPA audit is omitted, the MOEA may order rectification and impose fines of up to NT$500,000 (approx. USD 15,625); persistent default can lead to deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (district tax office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal year: by 31 May of the following year; for a special fiscal year: within five months after the fiscal year closes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 1% of the underpaid tax amount for each two-day period, capped at 15%; late filing surcharge scales from NT$1,500 (approx. USD 47) to NT$30,000 (approx. USD 937); interest is charged at the postal-bank base rate plus 1% per annum until full settlement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance Return and Money Remittance License Renewal Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) - Banking Bureau; Central Bank of Taiwan for foreign exchange reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year end (31 March for calendar-year companies) and on such other dates as the FSC license imposes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or submission of false AML/CFT data may result in administrative fines up to NT$5,000,000 (approx. USD 156,250), restriction or suspension of currency exchange and remittance operations, and revocation of the special remittance license under the Banking Act and Money Laundering Control Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership and Major Shareholder Register Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOEA Beneficial Ownership Information System; statutory books maintained at registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation aligned with the shareholders' meeting; qualifying shareholding or beneficial ownership transfers must be reported within 15 days under the Company Act or, for FSC/AML licence purposes, within the 30-day reporting window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update or confirm the register renders responsible persons liable to fines of NT$10,000 to NT$500,000 (approx. USD 312 to 15,625); the FSC may treat repeated registry failures as an AML compliance breach and escalate to license suspension.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For a Taiwan WFOE limited liability company, an independent certified public accountant (CPA) audit is statutorily required under Article 20 of the Company Act where any of the following quantitative thresholds is met: (i) paid-in capital exceeds NT$30,000,000 (approx. USD 937,500); (ii) annual operating revenue exceeds NT$60,000,000 (approx. USD 1,875,000); (iii) total assets exceed NT$300,000,000 (approx. USD 9,375,000) or total liabilities exceed NT$200,000,000 (approx. USD 6,250,000); (iv) the company employs more than 100 full-time staff in any month of the fiscal year; or (v) a special regulated license, such as the FSC money remittance authorization under ISIC 6619, imposes audited financial statements as a condition of license renewal. The remittance agency license automatically triggers a mandatory CPA audit irrespective of small-entity thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements must be prepared in accordance with Taiwan-IFRS (T-IFRS) as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission for entities subject to audit; non-public companies below the full IFRS scope may apply the Small and Medium Enterprise Financial Reporting Framework approved by the MOEA. A licensed cross-border remittance company is expected to apply T-IFRS for the statutory audit and additional FSC-directed reporting standards for money transmission and custody balances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Taiwan's Company Act and Money Laundering Control Act, a non-public WFOE must maintain a shareholders' and beneficial-ownership register at the registered office. Any transfer of shares or change in a major shareholder holding at least 10% of shares or any qualifying beneficial owner must be reported to the MOEA within 15 days of the change; for the FSC licensed remittance activity, a 30-day reporting window is applied to shareholding transfers and the annual AML/CFT return serves as the annual confirmation of ownership data. The board and corporate secretary must reconcile the register to the shareholders' ledger, option schedules and trust structures at each annual general meeting and keep the register available for inspection by the competent authority.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Major Beneficial Owners and AML Ownership Register
Register of Mortgages and Secured Obligations
Statutory Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings and Board Meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No free-zone or patent-box relief applies to a wholly foreign-owned financial/remittance agency. Standard 25% applies on worldwide income. A qualifying Small and Low-Profit Enterprise may benefit from a 20% statutory reduced rate with an effective 5% preferential rate on annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million (2023-2027), but only if revenue and asset thresholds are met. R&D super deductions and qualified resident dividend exemptions are not relevant to a pure consumer money-service business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A05001 (Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return, Type A) plus supporting schedules such as A105000 and related-party transaction schedules, filed through the State Taxation Administration e-tax electronic filing system at the local competent tax bureau portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing with quarterly estimated prepayment installments (filed within 15 days after each quarter-end); annual settlement return due within 5 months after the calendar-year end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: By May 31 of the following tax year for the annual return and self-assessment; quarterly prepayments are due by April 15, July 15, October 15, and January 15, or the next business day if the statutory date falls on a non-working day.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross income from commission charges, settlement fees, currency conversion spreads, and transaction service fees earned from cross-border remittance agency services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report globally sourced revenue as a Chinese tax-resident WFOE. Do not net out intercompany cost allocations. Related-party revenue originating from the Taiwan shareholder or affiliated payment processors must be identified and supported by contemporaneous comparables.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs directly attributable to remittance processing, including bank clearing fees, message-switching charges, and SWIFT/network partner costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reallocations from the Taiwan parent must be justified by a valid transfer-pricing policy. Inflated clearing fees paid to an affiliated Taiwan or third-country hook create a non-arm's length adjustment and a potential deemed dividend.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value-added tax, urban construction tax, education surcharges, and other indirect taxes relating to the taxable services, where not creditable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CIT is deductible only for non-CIT taxes; VAT input credits are reported separately on the VAT return schedule, not on the CIT A05001. Ensure no double-counting of Taiwan branch taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 (Line 4) - Selling, Administrative, and Financial Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general and administrative expenses, impairment provisions, and financial expense items arising in the ordinary course of consumer remittance transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party charges to the Taiwan entity for marketing, call-center support, brand license, and managerial services are deductible only if arm's length, actually incurred, materially documented, and not in substance a repatriation of profit. Expense support with no substance will be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 1 less Lines 2-6, plus investment income, fair-value changes, and asset impairment recoveries, produces operating profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the related-party margin deviates from the arm's length range, usually a comparable operating margin benchmark under TNMM for a commission-based remittance agent, the tax authority may adjust the operating profit upward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit before tax determined under PRC GAAP, after adding non-operating income and deducting non-operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile accounting profit to CIT taxable income. Non-resident-source charges that are accrual but not paid, property not used in China, or excessive provisions for AML litigation costs must be added back in the A105000 schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Lines 14-23 - Taxable Income Reconciliations and Tax Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back and deduction items including transfer-pricing adjustments, interest thin-capitalisation restriction, charitable donations, tax losses, and domestic dividend exemption; final tax payable at 25%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete the related-party transaction disclosure schedules with the Taiwan parent and affiliates. Failure to disclose related-party amounts with a remittance-flow conflict is treated as tax fraud and triggers an extended investigation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 fine, rising to RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000 if the tax bureau warns first. Late payment: daily surcharge of 0.05% of unpaid tax from the statutory due date. Tax evasion: administrative penalty of 50% to 5x the underpaid tax plus interest; criminal tax evasion above statutory thresholds under Criminal Law Article 201 carries up to 7 years imprisonment and fines; relevant directors and beneficial owners may be subjected to exit ban/blacklisting under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection Article 44 until unpaid tax is settled.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on outbound dividends paid by a Chinese WFOE to a non-resident enterprise shareholder under CIT Law Article 3, Article 37, and Article 59, before any relief under the Cross-Strait tax arrangement or exception for Chinese-listed shares.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation, where in force, or any other applicable DTA: (1) obtain a Taiwan Tax Residency Certificate from the Taiwan tax authority for the tax year of distribution; (2) complete the Chinese tax authorities' non-resident claimant beneficial ownership form, evidencing that the Taiwan shareholder is the beneficial owner and not a conduit; (3) prove a direct shareholding of at least 25% of the WFOE's capital if claiming the 5% dividend rate; (4) file the treaty-relief application with the withholding agent before remittance, or claim a refund within three years of the due date; and (5) update the beneficial ownership certification annually or upon capital change. For non-treaty residents, WHT of 10% applies at source and is a final tax for the non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: statutory 10% WHT at source, reduced to 7% under the Cross-Strait tax arrangement; royalties: statutory 10% WHT, reduced to 3% under the Cross-Strait arrangement when the Taiwan recipient is the beneficial owner. For a remittance agency, software platform subscriptions, trademark fees for the remittance brand, and SWIFT-related licensing fees paid to a Taiwan affiliate must satisfy the royalty definition and beneficial ownership requirement; interest on intercompany debt must also respect thin-capitalisation limits, debt/equity ratio 2:1, otherwise excess interest is treated as a deemed dividend subject to dividend WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File contemporaneous documentation is mandatory in the PRC where annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million for tangible assets, RMB 100 million for financial assets, RMB 100 million for intangible assets, or RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions. Master File is required if total annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion, or if cross-border related-party transactions involve two or more jurisdictions and exceed RMB 500 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Chinese GAAR under CIT Law Article 47 and general anti-abuse doctrine allow re-characterisation of a remittance SPV that lacks real commercial substance. The WFOE must demonstrate employees, licensed payment acceptance infrastructure, settlement interfaces, AML/CFT compliance staff, board decision-making, and risk management in mainland China as Core Income-Generating Activities. If the WFOE is a mere channel for Taiwan-controlled flows, the tax authorities may disregard the entity, re-attribute profits to the actual service provider, impose WHT on deemed distributions, and apply economic-substance and payment-licence tests administered by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange and the People's Bank of China.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Cross-Border Profit Shift
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE accumulates years of losses while continuously remitting commission, licence, call-center, and management-support fees to the Taiwan shareholder or related parties at non-arm's length prices, with fabricated or missing comparables, and the remittance fee paid to the Taiwan entity is not actually performed by any Taiwan employee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Articles 41, 44, 48 and Implementing Regulations; SAT Announcement 42/2016. The tax authority adjusts the transaction to arm's length, disallows inflated deductions, imposes underpayment interest at market rate plus penalties under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection Article 63 of 50%-5x of the tax shortfall, and may extend the statute of limitations to 10 years for deliberate concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who approves false transfer-pricing records is personally liable for joint restitution under Company Law if the limited liability is abused to evade taxes; the tax authority may impose an exit ban under the collection law until tax is paid. Criminal Law Article 201 exposes responsible directors to up to 7 years imprisonment and fines for fraudulent tax declarations; a court may pierce the corporate veil and order personal asset recovery where the WFOE is a pure conduit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE labels a distribution of retained profits to the Taiwan shareholder as an IT service fee or consulting fee, with no service obligation, no delivery evidence, and no commercial rationale, solely to avoid the 10% dividend withholding tax; the supposed recipient is not the beneficial owner and immediately passes the money onward.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Article 47, Article 3, Article 37, and Notice 2017 No. 37 re-characterise the payment as a dividend; the deduction is denied; 10% dividend WHT is collected from the WFOE as withholding agent; late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day and a 50%-5x administrative penalty for false declaration apply; criminal liability arises under Criminal Law Article 201 for intentionally evading tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign sham service agreements and approve the outward payment are jointly liable for the unpaid WHT; they may be blacklisted and denied exit by Chinese frontier inspection under the exit-restriction administrative measure; criminal prosecution of the responsible officer can lead to asset freezing, civil restitution to the tax authority, and imprisonment from 3 to 7 years where the amount is enormous and exceeds 30% of the legally payable tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE operates as a shell with no substantial personnel and uses the remittance rails to move funds for expatriate workers while making false declarations of the true economic activity, lacking the compulsory payment licence under People's Bank of China regulation, and using the Taiwan parent's network to conceal the ultimate payment origin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Anti-Money Laundering Law Articles 32-33, Criminal Law Article 191 on money laundering, and Criminal Law Article 225 on illegal business operation. The central bank may revoke the payment business qualification, impose fines up to RMB 5 million and confiscate illegal gains; the tax authority may impose an additional 50%-5x tax penalty under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection Article 63 for knowingly false tax returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: directors who control the shell are liable for unpaid tax and AML fines with personal assets; they are placed on the individual exit blacklist by the tax and immigration authorities; criminal conviction for money laundering carries up to 7 years imprisonment for related laundering acts, and evasion of tax can yield an additional term of up to 7 years, to be served concurrently or consecutively as ordered by the court.
